nodes.description: Transfer tax rate in basis points, default 800 (8%), owner-updatable up to MAXIMUM_TRANSFER_TAX_RATE (10%).
Burn rate percentage of the transfer tax, default 12, owner-updatable up to 100.
Privileged operator address set in the constructor to the deployer; gates every onlyowner function.
Single address exempted from the max-transaction check in _transfer, modifiable only via setAllowance.
Sell/transfer cap value used in require(amount < _total) inside _transfer; freely rewritable by setFee, this is the honeypot switch.
Anti-whale rate in percent used by maxTransferAmount(), owner-updatable.
Boolean gate enabling automatic swap-and-liquify inside _transfer.
Threshold of accumulated tokens required before liquidity is added, owner-updatable.
Uniswap V2 router instance used for swaps and liquidity, replaceable by the owner.
Liquidity pair address derived from the router factory; used to detect sells in _transfer.
Reentrancy guard boolean toggled by the lockTheSwap modifier.
Mapping of addresses exempt from the anti-whale transfer cap, owner-controlled.
Ownable owner address used by the inherited onlyOwner modifier (distinct from the token _operator).
Total token supply, increased by _deliver and decreased by _burn.
Private balance mapping (misnamed _fee) holding all token balances.
Mapping of delegator to delegatee used by the YAM-style vote checkpointing code.
Per-signatory nonce mapping used for replay protection in delegateBySig.
Constructor: initializes name/symbol, sets _operator to the deployer and populates anti-whale exclusions.
deliver(uint256 amount) onlyowner: mints tokens to the operator (exposed mint function).
deliver(address _to, uint256 _amount) onlyowner: mints arbitrary tokens to an arbitrary address and moves delegates.
setFee(uint256 percent) onlyowner: overwrites _total = percent * 10**18, the hidden honeypot control.
setAllowance(address) onlyowner: sets the privileged _tAllowAddress that bypasses the max-transaction check.
Override of _transfer applying anti-whale checks, optional swapAndLiquify, the _total sell limit and the 8% tax/burn/liquidity split.
Private swapAndLiquify with lockTheSwap/transferTaxFree: converts contract tokens to ETH and adds liquidity.
Private swapTokensForEth: approves and calls the router swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with block.timestamp as deadline.
Private addLiquidity: external call to router.addLiquidityETH forwarding ETH, with block.timestamp deadline and _operator as recipient.
View returning totalSupply() * maxTransferAmountRate / 100.
onlyowner setter for transferTaxRate capped at 1000 bps.
onlyowner setter for burnRate capped at 100.
onlyowner setter for maxTransferAmountRate capped at 1000000 (effectively unlimited).
onlyowner setter for minAmountToLiquify.
onlyowner setter to add/remove addresses from the anti-whale exclusion mapping.
onlyowner toggles automatic swap-and-liquify.
onlyowner setter for the router and derived pair, allowing an arbitrary malicious router.
External signature-based delegation using EIP-712 digest, ecrecover, nonces and the now<=expiry timestamp check.
Internal mint helper: unchecked _totalSupply += amount and _fee[account] += amount.
payable receive() accepting ETH from the router swap, the callback entry point during swapAndLiquify.
External delegate(address) forwarding msg.sender to _delegate.
Binary-search view over checkpoints for historical voting power.
Internal delegation update writing _delegates and moving votes.
Internal vote checkpoint adjustment between source and destination representatives.
msg.sender / _msgSender(): externally controlled caller used for ownership, operator checks and transfers.
block.timestamp / now: used as router deadlines and as the signature expiry check.
Privileged arbitrary overwrite of _total which silently arms the sell-blocking require in _transfer.
require(amount < _total) executed only for sells (recipient == uniSwapPair and sender != _tAllowAddress); combined with setFee it blocks all sells.
External call to the owner-supplied router swap function; can re-enter or be replaced by a malicious router.
External call transferring ETH to the owner-supplied router addLiquidityETH.
Unlimited privileged minting through deliver()/_deliver() despite the 'No mint code' claim.
ecrecover used for delegation without malleability protection; paired with the now<=expiry timestamp dependency.
Owner can point uniSwapRouter at an arbitrary contract, enabling theft of tokens approved to the router.
amount: mint amount passed to deliver(uint256).
_to: mint destination address in deliver(address,uint256).
_amount: mint amount in deliver(address,uint256).
percent: attacker/owner controlled multiplier used to set _total (honeypot trigger).
allowAddress: address granted tax/max-tx exemption via _tAllowAddress.
sender: source address of the internal _transfer.
recipient: destination address of the internal _transfer; compared against uniSwapPair to detect sells.
amount: transferred token amount, split into tax/burn/liquidity/send portions.
_transferTaxRate: new tax rate in basis points.
_burnRate: new burn percentage of the tax.
_maxTransferAmountRate: new anti-whale rate.
_minAmount: new minimum amount to liquify.
_account: address to include/exclude from anti-whale checks.
_excluded: boolean flag for the anti-whale exclusion mapping.
_enabled: boolean flag for swapAndLiquifyEnabled.
_router: arbitrary router address set by the owner.
delegatee: address receiving delegated votes.
nonce: signature replay-protection counter in delegateBySig.
expiry: timestamp upper bound compared with now in delegateBySig.
tokenAmount: tokens approved and swapped for ETH.
ethAmount: ETH value forwarded with addLiquidityETH.
blockNumber: historical block for vote lookup.
taxAmount = amount.mul(transferTaxRate).div(10000).
burnAmount = taxAmount.mul(burnRate).div(100).
liquidityAmount = taxAmount.sub(burnAmount).
sendAmount = amount.sub(taxAmount), amount actually delivered to the recipient.
contractTokenBalance = balanceOf(address(this)) clamped to maxTransferAmount().
liquifyAmount = minAmountToLiquify, the amount split for the swap.
half = liquifyAmount.div(2), the token half swapped for ETH.
otherHalf = liquifyAmount.sub(half), the token half paired with ETH.
initialBalance = address(this).balance captured before the swap.
newBalance = address(this).balance.sub(initialBalance), ETH received from the swap.
signatory = ecrecover(digest, v, r, s) recovered in delegateBySig.
nCheckpoints = numCheckpoints[account] read in getPriorVotes.
path = [address(this), uniSwapRouter.WETH()] swap route.

edges.reason: Constructor stores msg.sender as the privileged _operator, granting all onlyowner powers.
Constructor pre-excludes deployer, address(0), the contract and BURN_ADDRESS from anti-whale checks.
Deployer address flows through _msgSender() in the constructor.
onlyowner modifier compares _operator against msg.sender before minting.
onlyowner modifier gates the two-argument deliver mint.
onlyowner modifier gates setFee which arms the honeypot.
onlyowner modifier gates setAllowance.
Transfers enter _transfer with sender derived from _msgSender().
onlyowner modifier on updateTransferTaxRate checks msg.sender.
onlyowner modifier on updateuniSwapRouter checks msg.sender.
delegate() forwards msg.sender to _delegate.
setFee overwrites _total with percent*10**18 completely unchecked.
setFee is the privileged write that produces the unsafe _total overwrite.
_total is read by require(amount < _total) which only executes on sells, blocking them.
The sell-path require inside _transfer implements the honeypot transfer limit.
setAllowance writes the privileged tax-exempt address _tAllowAddress.
_tAllowAddress is compared in _transfer to skip the max-transaction check for the operator's ally.
swapAndLiquifyEnabled gates the automatic swap during a transfer.
_inSwapAndLiquify guard is checked before re-entering swapAndLiquify.
antiWhale modifier consults _excludedFromAntiWhale for sender and recipient.
uniSwapPair comparison identifies sells and triggers the abortive require.
_transfer invokes swapAndLiquify before applying tax when conditions hold.
taxAmount computed with SafeMath mul/div on user-supplied amount.
burnAmount derived from taxAmount and burnRate.
liquidityAmount = taxAmount - burnAmount.
sendAmount = amount - taxAmount determines what the recipient receives.
Contract token balance read and clamped to maxTransferAmount().
liquifyAmount copied from minAmountToLiquify.
half = liquifyAmount.div(2).
otherHalf = liquifyAmount.sub(half).
initialBalance snapshots the contract ETH balance before swapping.
newBalance = address(this).balance.sub(initialBalance).
swapAndLiquify calls swapTokensForEth(half).
swapAndLiquify calls addLiquidity(otherHalf, newBalance).
swapAndLiquify queries maxTransferAmount() for the clamp.
minAmountToLiquify is the threshold controlling whether the swap executes.
swapTokensForEth uses uniSwapRouter.WETH() and the router swap entry point.
External call to uniSwapRouter.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with attacker-influenceable router.
The router swap returns ETH to the token, re-entering the payable receive() while state is mid-update.
External call forwarding ETH to router.addLiquidityETH.
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline, a miner-manipulable value.
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
now <= expiry timestamp dependency in delegateBySig signature validation.
_operator is passed as the liquidity recipient.
maxTransferAmount uses totalSupply().mul(maxTransferAmountRate).div(100).
maxTransferAmount reads maxTransferAmountRate.
Owner can raise transferTaxRate up to 10% of every transfer.
Owner can modify burnRate.
Owner can set maxTransferAmountRate up to 1000000, effectively disabling anti-whale.
Owner controls the liquify threshold.
Owner can exempt any address from anti-whale limits.
Owner toggles automatic swapping behavior affecting every transfer.
Owner can replace uniSwapRouter with an arbitrary contract.
uniSwapPair is re-derived from the arbitrary router factory, also enabling honeypot sell detection changes.
Router replacement is the unsafe privileged operation that can drain tokens approved to the router.

deliver(address,uint256) calls the unchecked internal _deliver mint.
deliver(address,uint256) moves vote delegates after minting.
_deliver performs unchecked _totalSupply += amount.
_deliver performs unchecked _fee[account] += amount.

signatory = ecrecover(digest, v, r, s) recovers the signer.
ecrecover usage with malleable (v,r,s) inputs and expiry-based acceptance.
nonces[signatory]++ provides replay protection inside delegateBySig.
_delegate calls _moveDelegates to adjust checkpoints.
_delegate writes _delegates[delegator] = delegatee.
getPriorVotes reads numCheckpoints[account] into nCheckpoints.

expiry parameter is compared against block.timestamp.
blockNumber parameter drives the checkpoint binary search.
